{{Quote|My old man was a trooper. Member of the 407th. Always talked about "the honor of the armor".|Anson Trask|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref>}}
'''Anson Trask's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served in the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]] of the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]]. His son, [[Anson Trask]], later followed in his footsteps and joined the same division during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
